introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.p1: The Defense Industry Engineering Group (DEIG) is Ethiopia's premier state-owned enterprise dedicated to advancing the nation's defense technology, manufacturing capabilities, and industrial self-reliance.
introduction.p2: As the central coordinating body for a network of specialized engineering industries, we play a strategic role in national security by designing, developing, and producing a wide array of defense systems and solutions.

missionVision.title: Our Mission & Vision
missionVision.mission_text: To develop and sustain a modern, self-reliant, and technologically advanced Ethiopian defense industrial base capable of meeting the nation's security needs and contributing to its economic growth.
missionVision.vision_text: To be a globally recognized leader in defense technology and manufacturing, renowned for our engineering prowess, strategic importance, and unwavering dedication to national sovereignty.

coreValues.title: Core Values
coreValues.excellence_text: A relentless pursuit of quality and precision.

structure.title: Organizational Structure
structure.footer: A synergistic structure ensuring specialized focus and collaborative innovation.

objectives.title: Strategic Objectives
objectives.modernization_desc: To upgrade and enhance the national defense manufacturing infrastructure with state-of-the-art technology and processes.
objectives.capability_desc: To foster a culture of continuous learning and skill development, ensuring our engineers are at the forefront of their fields.
objectives.innovation_desc: To invest in research and development to create next-generation defense solutions and reduce technological dependence.
objectives.efficiency_desc: To optimize our production lines, supply chains, and management practices for greater efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

quality.title: Quality, Safety & Compliance
quality.intro: Our commitment to quality is unwavering. We adhere to internationally recognized standards, including ISO certifications, to ensure every product meets the highest levels of performance, reliability, and safety.

achievements.title: Achievements & Milestones
achievements.growth_desc: Stimulating local economies through industrial activity, job creation, and supply chain development.
achievements.tech_desc: Fostering innovation and knowledge-sharing that benefits the broader civilian technology sector.
achievements.workforce_desc: Training a highly skilled generation of engineers, technicians, and specialists in advanced manufacturing.
achievements.security_desc: Ensuring national sovereignty and security through the provision of reliable, state-of-the-art defense systems.

introduction.title: Why Join DEIG?
introduction.p1: Working at DEIG means being part of a mission-critical organization dedicated to national progress. We foster a culture of innovation, excellence, and continuous learning, offering our employees the unique opportunity to work on challenging projects that have a real impact.

whyJoin.impactDesc: Contribute directly to Ethiopia's sovereignty and technological advancement.
whyJoin.projectsDesc: Work on innovative and challenging projects at the forefront of defense engineering.
whyJoin.growthDesc: Access continuous training, development programs, and clear paths for career progression.

life.title: Our Culture & Environment
life.p1: We believe in fostering a collaborative and dynamic workplace where innovation thrives. Our teams are composed of dedicated professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges. We invest in our people, providing a supportive environment that encourages both personal and professional growth.
life.quote: The opportunity to work on projects of this scale and importance is incredibly rewarding. There's a real sense of shared purpose here.

process.title: Application Process
process.s1Desc: Submit your application and CV through our secure online portal.
process.s2Desc: Our HR team reviews your application to match your skills with our needs.
process.s3Desc: Qualified candidates undergo interviews and/or technical assessments.
process.s4Desc: Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the DEIG team.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.faq1q: Can I apply for multiple positions?
faq.faq1a: Yes, you are welcome to apply for any positions for which you meet the qualifications. Please submit a separate application for each role.
faq.faq2q: How long does the recruitment process take?
faq.faq2a: The timeline can vary depending on the role, but we strive to keep candidates informed throughout the process, which typically takes 4-6 weeks from the closing date.
faq.faq3a: Yes, we offer internship programs for university students in relevant fields. These are typically announced on our website and social media channels.

productionPage.title: Production & Manufacturing Excellence
productionPage.subtitle: Leveraging advanced technology and precision engineering to deliver superior defense solutions.

overview.title: Overview of Production Operations
overview.p1: Our production philosophy is centered on precision, reliability, and efficiency. Adhering to the strictest international manufacturing standards, we operate state-of-the-art facilities designed for the end-to-end production of advanced defense systems. Our key capabilities span the entire manufacturing lifecycle, from raw material processing to final system integration and testing.

s1.title: Raw Material Preparation
s1.desc: Sourcing and rigorous inspection of high-grade materials to meet stringent specifications.

s2.title: Component Manufacturing
s2.desc: Utilizing CNC machining, forging, and composite fabrication to produce precision components.

s3.title: Assembly & Integration
s3.desc: Systematic assembly of components into subsystems and final products on dedicated production lines.

s4.title: Testing & Validation
s4.desc: Comprehensive testing of every component and system for performance, reliability, and safety.

s5.title: Quality Control
s5.desc: Continuous quality assurance checks at every stage to ensure adherence to standards.

s6.title: Packaging & Delivery
s6.desc: Secure, military-grade packaging and logistical management for safe delivery.

cnc.title: CNC Machining
cnc.desc: High-precision, multi-axis CNC machines for complex and intricate component manufacturing.

robotics.title: Robotics & Automation
robotics.desc: Automated welding, assembly, and material handling to ensure consistency and efficiency.

cadcam.title: CAD/CAM Systems
cadcam.desc: Integrated design and manufacturing software for seamless transition from digital model to physical product.

quality.title: Quality Assurance & Testing
quality.p1: Quality is the bedrock of our manufacturing process. Our dedicated Quality Assurance department employs a multi-faceted approach to ensure every product that leaves our facilities is flawless, reliable, and meets or exceeds all required specifications.

rd.title: R&D in Production
rd.p1: Innovation is integrated directly into our production floor. We invest in continuous improvement programs and prototyping facilities to refine manufacturing processes, adopt new technologies, and enhance product performance.

safety.title: Environmental & Safety Standards
safety.p1: We are committed to responsible manufacturing. Our operations adhere to strict environmental and safety protocols to ensure the well-being of our workforce and the protection of our environment through waste management and energy efficiency programs.

contact.title: Contact for Production Inquiries
contact.p1: For inquiries related to our production capabilities, partnerships, or procurement, please contact our production management team.
